quotes.text: Build an integration where you render the Payment Element before you create a PaymentIntent or SetupIntent, then confirm the Intent from your server.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: You can use the ConfirmationToken sent by your client to create and confirm the PaymentIntent in a single request.
To set up a payment method for future payments, you must attach it to an object that represents your customer.

findings: Semantic raw delta: November raw lines 5-15 retain the common deferred-Element/server-confirm identity and expose three web variant URLs, while May old raw lines 8-734, 734-1570 and 1571-2541 contain detailed payment, setup and subscription flows. Diff lines 1-13 and 2542-2544 show a combined guide replaced by an index, not evidence that detailed behavior was deprecated or newly changed.

Existing summary baseline accuracy: source lines 13-30 reasonably describe the May payment variant, but source lines 32-34 call setup 'Same' without the May requirement to attach the method to a customer-configured Account or Customer (old raw lines 1118-1128), and the source lacks the subscription variant, whose example creates a default_incomplete Subscription and separately confirms its invoice PaymentIntent (old raw lines 2446-2490). Both variants are explicitly discoverable in new raw lines 14-15.

The May payment variant uses client Elements mode/amount/currency and paymentMethodCreation manual, elements.submit and createConfirmationToken, then server trusted amount and PaymentIntent create/confirm (old raw lines 82-103, 455-465, 491-536, 647-675). The SetupIntent is distinct from payment and must not imply a charge (old raw lines 734-738, 1374-1402). New raw lines 7-15 do not refresh those detailed instructions.

May outcome boundary: requires_action calls for client handleNextAction, and payment_intent.succeeded events should drive post-payment work rather than a client callback (old raw lines 689-720). The source line 30 mentions next action but not reliable completion; the new raw lines 7-15 establish no succeeded state or transaction outcome.

Main route exists: root wiki/index.md line 7 routes to wiki/stripe-index.md lines 558 and 729, then wiki/concepts/stripe-payment-intents.md lines 43-48 and 145-148 routes the current source. Source lines 46-48 preserve the May raw link, but the November index raw is not represented.

Attempt 2 targeted reassignment retains attempt-1 receipt full-read proof for every pinned file (receipt SHA-256 0504eb680cefdc9e2f3d56887ce5d190679a7f9017be469e69b25823fc5c284f, read_ranges), while this worker personally reread the new raw lines 1-15, current source lines 1-48, old raw targeted ranges and diff endpoints recorded as additional ranges. All four pinned SHA-256 values and prior receipt/review hashes match trusted input.

Baseline provenance defect: current source frontmatter lines 1-9 omits canonical_url, despite the trusted canonical URL and new raw line 1. Repair it with https://docs.stripe.com/payments/finalize-payments-on-the-server when proposing the dual-raw route; the omission is not a November semantic change.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Keep the May 11, 2026 payment-flow details dated: manual Payment Element configuration, 12-hour unused ConfirmationToken expiry, server PaymentIntent create/confirm and client next-action handling (old raw lines 82-103, 455-465, 635-720; current source lines 13-30).

Keep May setup prerequisites and outcome distinct: customer-configured Account or Customer attachment, SetupIntent confirmation, and separate later off-session PaymentIntent with possible 402/authentication-required failure (old raw lines 1118-1128, 1374-1537).

Keep May subscription path distinct: recurring Price and customer prerequisites, immediate-charge amount or trial zero, invoice settings consistency, default_incomplete Subscription then latest-invoice PaymentIntent confirmation (old raw lines 1592-1598, 1647-1658, 2024-2028, 2163-2165, 2446-2490).
The seven SDK minimum versions in source lines 36-38 come from the dated May payment section old raw lines 635-645; the November index gives no version update.

The dated May guide explicitly excludes BLIK and ACSS pre-authorized debits for this integration path; client-side deferred-intent creation cannot use customer_balance with dynamic payment methods because that PaymentIntent needs a customer-configured Account or Customer, so the guide directs a server-created PaymentIntent with that object and a returned client_secret (old raw lines 27-31, repeated 753-757 and 1590-1594). November index lines 7-15 do not renew availability or deprecate this warning.

The May Accounts v2 customer-configured Account route has a dated access condition: GA for Connect users and public preview for other Stripe users, with a preview API version for participants (old raw lines 1120-1128, also 974-980 and 1823-1829). Do not present Accounts v2 as universally available; Customer remains the alternative.
conflicts: The May example returns client_secret/status in old raw lines 673-676 yet its handleNextAction example accesses response.clientSecret in old raw lines 699-703 (also setup old raw lines 1399-1402 versus 1425-1429). Treat this as an example naming inconsistency, not demonstrated runtime behavior; current source lines 29-30 reproduce the mismatch and need a narrow warning or consistent conceptual wording.

Current source lines 19-22 present a broad deferred-versus-server comparison; the May server variant examples use paymentMethodCreation manual (old raw lines 86-103), while the general Elements options table labels it optional (old raw lines 428-453). Scope the setting to the shown variant rather than a universal Stripe.js requirement.
unresolved_questions: The November index points to three variant URLs (new raw lines 13-15) but their 2026-11-07 detailed contents were not pinned here; any current variant behavior, SDK minimum or availability change needs separately authorized capture.

findings: Add the 2026-11-07 raw as a navigation-only capture and retain the 2026-05-11 guide as dated implementation authority (new raw lines 7-15; old raw lines 1-12; current source lines 4-8, 46-48).

Repair baseline coverage: source lines 32-34 flatten SetupIntent prerequisites and omit the subscription branch, although old raw lines 1118-1128 and 2446-2490 distinguish them and new raw lines 14-15 route to them.
Qualify next-action and completion boundaries using old raw lines 689-720; avoid claiming the new index proves successful payments.

Preserve the May payment-method warning as dated: BLIK and ACSS pre-authorized debit exclusion; customer_balance with dynamic methods is unavailable for the client-created deferred intent and needs a server-created PaymentIntent with customer-configured Account or Customer and returned client_secret (old raw lines 27-31, 753-757, 1590-1594; new raw lines 7-15 does not renew it).

Qualify the customer-configured Account option: May Accounts v2 guidance says GA for Connect, public preview for other Stripe users, and preview-version configuration for participants (old raw lines 1120-1128, also 974-980 and 1823-1829); current source lines 32-34 flatten setup.

Add missing canonical_url: https://docs.stripe.com/payments/finalize-payments-on-the-server to current source frontmatter lines 1-9, alongside the dual raw route; this is a baseline provenance/schema defect, not a raw semantic delta.
conflicts: May sample response field client_secret at old raw lines 673-676 conflicts with response.clientSecret at old raw lines 699-703; current source lines 29-30 echo both spellings.

The old raw lines 428-453 optional Elements table and payment variant old raw lines 86-103 support a variant-specific manual setting, not a universal rule; current source lines 17-22 risk overgeneralization.
source_assessments.reason: November raw is a navigation-only index, but the May-derived source needs dated dual-raw provenance, canonical_url, setup/subscription coverage, payment-method and Accounts v2 qualifications, and resolution of an example-field mismatch (new raw lines 7-15; old raw lines 27-31, 1120-1128, 2446-2490; current source lines 1-9, 29-38, 46-48).

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/finalize-payments-on-the-server, the November capture establishes rendering the Payment Element before a PaymentIntent or SetupIntent exists, then server confirmation, and lists separate web payment, setup and subscription variants (new raw lines 5-15). The dated May guide adds client submit and ConfirmationToken, trusted server amount and PaymentIntent create/confirm, requires_action handling and event-based post-payment work (old raw lines 455-465, 647-720). Setup attaches a method to a customer-configured Account or Customer and confirms a SetupIntent without immediate charge; the Account path was GA for Connect and preview for others with a preview version required for participants (old raw lines 734-738, 1118-1128). Subscription uses Price/customer, default_incomplete Subscription and separate invoice PaymentIntent confirmation (old raw lines 2446-2490). May also excludes BLIK and ACSS pre-authorized debits; client-created deferred Intents cannot use customer_balance with dynamic methods, so that case needs a server-created PaymentIntent with Account or Customer and returned client_secret (old raw lines 27-31). The mapped source-stripe-finalize-payments-server.md summarizes payment but flattens setup, omits subscription and canonical_url (current source lines 1-9, 13-38). Neither capture establishes successful payment, settlement or current variant availability.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/finalize-payments-on-the-server, the November change is presentation and variant navigation, not a demonstrated substantive flow change: a detailed combined May guide became a short index (new raw lines 7-15; old raw lines 8-12, 734-738, 1571-1575; diff lines 1-13, 2542-2544). The mapped source-stripe-finalize-payments-server.md needs the new raw route and missing canonical_url, but must retain its May ConfirmationToken, SDK minima, next-action, setup and subscription claims as dated (current source lines 1-9, 26-48; old raw lines 635-720, 1118-1128, 2446-2490). Keep May's BLIK/ACSS and conditional customer_balance restriction and Accounts v2 Connect GA versus other-user preview warning; November's index does not renew or deprecate them (old raw lines 27-31, 1120-1128; new raw lines 7-15). The May sample returns client_secret but accesses response.clientSecret, a code example conflict requiring a warning (old raw lines 673-703; current source lines 29-30). Scope manual Elements configuration to the shown web variant, distinguish SetupIntent from PaymentIntent and Subscription/invoice payment states, and use payment_intent.succeeded events for post-payment work rather than treating a browser callback or server request as success (old raw lines 86-103, 689-720).
